note: Two dissociable camouflage mechanisms (semantic mimicry vs texture continuity) with a human-anchored factor analysis; psychophysics rigor is the entry fee. Anchors the whole C06 reform agenda.
Center/single-object bias stress test is cheap and probably damning; center bias is an old SOD critique so the COD-specific empirical numbers are the only new asset.
Video-COD on MoCA is an established subfield, so 'motion helps camouflage' is known; the bits-per-frame information curve is the surviving quantitative delta.

Joint SOD-COD modeling exploiting their contradictory relationship is published (uncertainty-aware joint SOD/COD, CVPR 2021); the linear-direction probe is a cleaner instrument for a settled question.

Mechanism-stratified evaluation grounded in camouflage biology (Cott's principles) is the right taxonomy; needs biologist annotation and multi-label handling, and COD10K's existing attributes partially overlap.

Consensus-core re-scoring is an afternoon of compute with a real chance of exposing style-imitation rewards; the annotation-team correlation is the killer figure if it lands. Merge candidate with 0091/0118 metric-reform line.

Machine-visible chromatic microstructure as a non-perceptual shortcut, tied to cross-camera failure, is a solid forensic; needs the human baseline and psychophysically-verified ablations it prescribes.
Bio-vs-artificial camouflage transfer is data-blocked (military camouflage sets are not public) and the phase-statistics story is speculative; defense-adjacent framing also complicates venues.
'COD progress is implicit scale-search progress' is a bold reduction; the oracle-leakage protocol problem (own note) is exactly where reviewers will aim, and the fix is nontrivial.
A quantified supervision-crossover criterion (when binary labels become counterproductive) is a reusable decision rule for every fuzzy class; matting data with true alpha makes it controlled.

'Ambiguity is more domain-invariant than object identity' is a genuinely deep claim with a clean zero-shot test; must control protocol/skill confounds (own note) and dodge the multi-rater modeling literature by staying on the transfer question.
Context-saturation curves as a computational task signature are cheap and tidy; the result is a characterization, and its main value is feeding the 0326 context-monotonicity agenda.

The COD-medical bridge is already built: the Concealed Object Detection line explicitly spans camouflage and polyp/lesion segmentation with shared architectures. Channel-ablation localization does not rescue it.
Conditional recall after the first find (inhibition-of-return deficit) is an original behavioral probe borrowed from visual-search psychology; ecology relevance (herds) gives it real stakes.
Compression-halo forensics of COD is hours-cheap with real embarrassment potential; overlaps 0018's grid-forensics toolkit - bundle as one 'artifact forensics' paper.
Time-accuracy curve matching is suggestive-only by its own admission (curve similarity is weak mechanistic evidence); the human data collection is the expensive half of a soft conclusion.

'Difficulty lives in the scene, not the animal' with a compositing intervention is a good causal design; COD10K attribute analyses have circled this without the intervention leg, which is the part to protect.
Testing whether undecidability itself is reliably annotatable is a foundational annotation-theory question disguised as a COD study; the exclusion-mask retraining leg makes it constructive.
Motion-magnification preprocessing for hidden-animal detection is plausible and cheap to pilot; overlaps 0042's micro-motion agenda (same bet, different task) - keep exactly one of the pair.

Datasets contain only failed camouflage - a selection-bias claim that bounds the unmeasurable, testable via telemetry-verified presence. Ecology collaboration is the wall; upside is a permanent asterisk on every COD number. Lit-attacked below.
May reduce to known contrast measures by its own admission; the angular component is a thin bet for a full project, and COD difficulty-attribute analyses already crowd this space.
Shadow-geometry as an unfakeable channel is physically sound with near-independent errors as the payoff claim; directional-light-only envelope and shadow-evidence annotation costs keep it borderline.
'Binary masks are the worst output format' is a causal HCI claim against the field's default deliverable, with anchoring as the mechanism; N=30 study is the entire cost. Lit-attacked below.
Physical/3D adversarial camouflage synthesis is a mature literature (adversarial textures, clothing, vehicle wraps); the transfer-matrix delta does not clear the bar.

Scale-relativity of boundary ground truth attacks an unexamined axiom (that a single correct boundary exists independent of viewing scale); if the systematic shift is real, mixed-resolution training is provably mis-specified. Interface controls are essential.
